sources.title: Stringjoy - Alternate Guitar Tunings: The Ultimate Guide
sources.summary: Drop D, down tunings, open tunings, DADGAD and common metal-oriented tunings are introduced as practical alternate-tuning families.

sources.title: Guitar.com - An introduction to alternate tunings: Drop D, Open G and DADGAD
sources.summary: Drop D, Open G and DADGAD are presented as common entry points for electric guitar alternate tunings.

sources.title: GuitarTuner.io - Open Tunings Explained
sources.summary: DADGAD, Open G, Open D, Open E and Open C are described as widely used open or modal tunings.

sources.title: Wikipedia - Guitar tunings
sources.summary: Lists standard, drop, open, regular and other guitar tuning families, including Drop D and Open D.

presets.name: Drop D
presets.description: Standard tuning with the 6th string lowered one whole step.

presets.name: Half-Step Down
presets.description: Every string tuned down one semitone.

presets.name: D Standard
presets.description: Every string tuned down one whole step from standard.

presets.name: Drop C
presets.description: D Standard with the 6th string dropped to C.

presets.name: DADGAD
presets.description: Modal Dsus4 tuning common in folk, Celtic and fingerstyle guitar.

presets.name: Open G
presets.description: Open G major tuning used often for blues, rock and slide.

presets.name: Open D
presets.description: Open D major tuning, also called Vestapol in some traditions.

presets.name: Open E
presets.description: Open E major tuning, closely related to Open D raised one whole step.

presets.name: Open C
presets.description: Open C major tuning with a broad, resonant low range.
